# >>> envden >>>
_envden_inside() {
  local directory="$2"
  while [ -n "$directory" ]; do
    [ "$directory" -ef "$1" ] && return 0
    [ "$directory" != / ] || break
    directory="${directory%/*}"
    [ -n "$directory" ] || directory=/
  done
  return 1
}
_envden_notice() {
  local saved_status=$?
  [ "${_envden_last_pwd-}" != "$PWD" ] || return "$saved_status"
  _envden_last_pwd="$PWD"
  local physical="$(pwd -P)"
  local root approved=0 cache='/home/test/.envden/state/notice' now modified
  [ -r '/home/test/.envden/state/approved-checkouts' ] && while IFS= read -r root; do
    [ -n "$root" ] || continue
    if _envden_inside "$root" "$physical"; then approved=1; break; fi
  done 2>/dev/null < '/home/test/.envden/state/approved-checkouts'
  local offered='/home/test/.envden/state/track-offered' root_seen=0 day line
  [ -r '/home/test/.envden/state/track-offers' ] && while IFS= read -r root; do
    [ -n "$root" ] || continue
    if _envden_inside "$root" "$physical"; then
      root_seen=0
      [ -r "$offered" ] && while IFS= read -r line; do [ "$line" != "$root" ] || root_seen=1; done 2>/dev/null < "$offered"
      if [ "$root_seen" = 0 ]; then
        printf '%s\n' 'envden: env files found; run envden track'
        printf '%s\n' "$root" >> "$offered"
      fi
      break
    fi
  done 2>/dev/null < '/home/test/.envden/state/track-offers'
  day=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
  [ -r '/home/test/.envden/state/notice-update' ] && while IFS= read -r line; do
    case "$line" in
      'envden: update required; run envden update') printf '%s\n' "$line" ;;
      'envden: update available; run envden update')
        if [ "$(cat -- '/home/test/.envden/state/update-offered-day' 2>/dev/null)" != "$day" ]; then
          printf '%s\n' "$line"
          printf '%s\n' "$day" > '/home/test/.envden/state/update-offered-day'
        fi ;;
    esac
  done 2>/dev/null < '/home/test/.envden/state/notice-update'
  if [ "$approved" = 1 ] && [ -f "$cache" ]; then LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176' < "$cache"; fi
  now=$(date +%s)
  modified=$(stat -c %Y "$cache" 2>/dev/null) || modified=$(stat -f %m "$cache" 2>/dev/null) || modified=0
  if [ "$((now - modified))" -gt 60 ]; then
    (env -u BUN_OPTIONS -u BUN_BE_BUN '/opt/envden'\''s bin/envden' status --refresh-cache </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &)
  fi
  return "$saved_status"
}
case ";${PROMPT_COMMAND:-};" in *'_envden_notice;'*) ;; *) PROMPT_COMMAND="_envden_notice;${PROMPT_COMMAND:-}" ;; esac
_envden_notice
